description: Search the core corpus, first-party essays, executable Labs, epistemic claims, the Homeric Atlas and the AI benchmarks (professions and benchmark catalogue) in one call. Use this first when a natural-language question might require a calculation, a long-form essay, a claim audit or a model choice rather than only a core knowledge unit. Results name the next tool to call; calculator-shaped questions are routed toward Labs, and 'which AI model for…' questions toward the benchmarks.

content_locales.description: Keep only results whose text is entirely in these languages. `locale` is a presentation preference and still returns substitutions, labelled; this is the hard filter. A result that mixes a language you did not allow is dropped, and so is one that cannot declare its languages.

limit_per_surface.description: Maximum hits from each surface. Default: 5.

locale.description: Language of the returned body. Default: en.

query.description: Question or topic, in English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Japanese or Simplified Chinese.

surfaces.description: Restrict the search. Omit to search all six surfaces.

name: search_all

empty_reason.description: Why a strict content_locales filter returned nothing.

requested_locale.description: The locale this search asked for.

content_locale.description: The single language the whole result is in, or null when it mixes languages. Filter on content_locales, not on this.

content_locales.description: Every language this result's text is actually in. More than one means the result mixes them — a localised title with an English summary, for instance.

fallback.description: True unless the whole result is in the requested language.

substituted_count.description: How many results are not in the requested language.

title: Search every SANTISMM knowledge surface
